_comment: D13-F3: token prefixes, TTLs, MintedToken shapes, access-token claims, decode error codes, key-ring derivation, hash/fingerprint vectors. All vectors executed against the real tokens.py with SECRET_KEY='d13-fixture-secret-key' (documented fixed key, NOT a real secret).

claims.rtg: int(rtg) — refresh-token generation that minted this token
claims._byte_order: INSERTION order (jwt.encode serializes in dict order — byte order): iss, sub, uid, wid, iat, exp, rtg (tokens.py:154-162)

access_token.expires_at_rule: datetime.fromtimestamp(now + ttl, tz=utc) — returned alongside raw; serialized to clients via .isoformat() (+00:00)
access_token.mint_signature: mint_access_token(*, runner_id, user_id, workspace_id, rtg, ttl_secs=None) -> AccessToken(raw, expires_at, kid). ttl defaults to settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECS (3600). kid = first status=='active' entry in ring order; RuntimeError('no active access-token signing key configured') when none active.
access_token.verifier_note: decode_access_token checks signature by kid + exp ONLY. rtg/revocation/runner checks live in the caller (authentication.py).

access_token_expired.trigger: exp in the past (verified: mint with past exp)

access_token_invalid.trigger: bad signature OR missing required claim (verified: wrong-secret mint -> invalid; mint without rtg -> invalid). Also wrong iss.

access_token_malformed.detail: PyJWT message (e.g. 'Not enough segments') or literal 'missing kid header'
access_token_malformed.trigger: unparseable header (verified: 'not-a-token') or header without kid (verified)

hashing.fingerprint: hex(sha256(raw.encode()))[:12] — first 12 hex chars, NO pepper (tokens.py:52-54)
hashing.pepper: sha256(('runner/pepper/' + SECRET_KEY).encode()).digest() — 32 raw bytes used as HMAC key (tokens.py:43-44)

key_ring.active_kid_rule: _active_kid returns the FIRST entry with status=='active' in dict order; RuntimeError when none (tokens.py:121-125)
key_ring.derivation: when the setting is missing OR falsy (None, []): {'default': {'secret': hex(sha256(('runner/access-token/' + SECRET_KEY).encode())), 'status': 'active'}} (tokens.py:108-111). NOTE: `if not keys` — an EXPLICIT [] also derives; production default in settings/common.py:592 IS [] so stock installs always derive.

method: Executed the real runner/services/tokens.py with django settings.configure(SECRET_KEY fixed, RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN_KEYS=[], ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECS=3600): prefixes/TTLs read off module consts; hash/fingerprint vectors computed; key-ring derivation double-checked against an independent hashlib recomputation (match); access-token mint executed live and decoded; all six decode-error triggers executed.
